description: Defines a MongoDB Index class with methods for creating, configuring, and representing index metadata, including index options like uniqueness, sparsity, background building, partial filter expressions, and expiration settings.

classes.name: Index
classes.description: Represents a MongoDB index with properties such as keys, name, uniqueness, sparsity, background creation, partial filter expression, and expiration. Provides methods for creating index instances, converting to MongoDB IndexModel, and modifying index options.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Index instance with specified keys, name, and index options (unique, sparse, background).

methods.name: indexInfoOf
methods.description: Creates an Index instance from a MongoDB Document containing index metadata.

methods.name: withExpireAfterSeconds
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Index with an expiration time set.

methods.name: withPartialFilterExpression
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Index with a specified partial filter expression.

methods.name: toIndexModel
methods.description: Converts the Index instance into a MongoDB IndexModel for index creation.

methods.name: isUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether the index is unique.

methods.name: isSparse
methods.description: Indicates whether the index is sparse.

methods.name: isBackground
methods.description: Indicates whether the index is built in the background.

methods.name: getExpireAfterSeconds
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the expiration time in seconds, if set.
